name: Category Card
title: Category Card
description: One product category: its picture (read from the database), figures and best sellers.

parameters.name: year
parameters.label: Year
parameters.optionsSql: SELECT DISTINCT year FROM sales ORDER BY 1 DESC

parameters.name: category
parameters.label: Category
parameters.optionsSql: SELECT name FROM categories ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: cat
datasets.sql: SELECT c.name, c.tagline, c.icon, c.color, coalesce(round(sum(s.revenue)), 0) AS revenue, coalesce(sum(s.quantity), 0) AS units, count(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS customers, coalesce(round(100.0 * (sum(s.revenue) - sum(s.cost)) / sum(s.revenue), 1), 0) AS margin FROM categories c LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.category = c.name AND s.year = :year WHERE c.name = :category GROUP BY c.name

datasets.name: products
datasets.sql: SELECT product, sum(quantity) AS units, round(sum(revenue)) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE year = :year AND category = :category GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
